newsitem.title: UK: Rothschild Asset Management revamp widens losses.
newsitem.headline: Rothschild Asset Management revamp widens losses.

text.p: Rothschild Asset Management (RAM), the fund management arm of merchant bank NM Rothschild, said on Monday that restructuring costs had contributed to pre-tax losses of 6.1 million stg for the year to March 31.

A spokesman for the group told Reuters that around half of the RAM London loss, which widened from 471,000 stg the previous year, related to substantial systems and IT development costs as well as severance payments.
The remainder was a trading loss, he added.

All Rothschild's asset management business had now been brought into a new holding company called Rothschild Asset Management BV, registered in Holland. The benefits of this new operation were already showing, he said.
"There has been a complete turnaround. The new RAM BV group is trading very profitably (for the five months to the end of August 1996)," the spokesman said.
He said a decision had not yet been made on whether the late Amschel Rothschild, who committed suicide in July, would be replaced as chairman of RAM London.
